analysis_status: designed before inspecting opportunity effects in the latent-state model; runs only if the two-season detection gate identifies at least five of six transitions
purpose: Separate a current focal-response-excluded opportunity association with latent interaction transitions from an association with current-period per-census detection probability.
scope: same six strict_dated_core_2008_2010 transitions and same focal-response-excluded candidate surface as the census-rate and two-season detection analyses

covariate.name: current_siteweek_opportunity_fraction
covariate.definition: fraction of focal-plant current site x ISO-week cells in which the focal pollinator is independently detected on at least one other plant

detection_only.role: tests whether opportunity acts only as a current detectability/activity covariate

state_only.role: tests latent colonization/persistence association without detection modulation

model_comparison.material_advantage: AIC at least 2 lower than comparator
model_comparison.state_evidence_rule: state component is called transition-level supported only when state_plus_detection has AIC at least 2 lower than detection_only and beta_gain > 0 and beta_loss < 0
model_comparison.detection_evidence_rule: detection component is called transition-level supported when detection_only has AIC at least 2 lower than base and beta_detection > 0
model_comparison.cross_transition_promotion: a general latent state-opportunity result requires transition-level state support in at least five of six transitions; otherwise report mixed/no general state effect

interpretation.allowed: diagnose whether current opportunity is more consistent with latent transition structure, detectability, both, or neither under the simple occupancy model
forbidden: treating AIC model preference as experimental identification
changing the state/detection parameterization after seeing coefficients
overriding a failed five-of-six state rule with pooled significance

claim_ceiling: Even if a latent state component is supported, this remains an observational detection-model sensitivity analysis. If detection-only explains the signal or the state rule is not met in five of six transitions, do not promote current opportunity as a general driver of ecological rewiring.
